{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.multinomial_two_mul_le_mul_multinomial",
      "informal_name": "Multinomial Inequality: Doubled Exponents ≤ (Sum^Sum) × Original",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → ℕ},\n  (Nat.multinomial s fun i => 2 * f i) ≤ ((∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ ∑ i ∈ s, f i) * Nat.multinomial s f",
      "informal_description": "For a finite set $ s $ and a function $ f : s → \\mathbb{N} $, the multinomial coefficient with all exponents doubled satisfies $ \\text{multinomial}(s, 2f) \\leq \\left(\\sum_{i \\in s} f(i)\\right)^{\\sum_{i \\in s} f(i)} \\cdot \\text{multinomial}(s, f) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.choose_le_pow",
      "informal_name": "Binomial Coefficient Inequality: $\\binom{n}{k} \\leq n^k$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n k : ℕ), n.choose k ≤ n ^ k",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\\binom{n}{k}$ is less than or equal to $n^k$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.choose_succ_le_two_pow",
      "informal_name": "Binomial Coefficient Inequality: $\\binom{n+1}{k} \\leq 2^n$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n k : ℕ), (n + 1).choose k ≤ 2 ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\\binom{n+1}{k}$ is less than or equal to $2^n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.pow_le_choose",
      "informal_name": "Upper Bound for Binomial Coefficient: $\\frac{(n + 1 - r)^r}{r!} \\leq \\binom{n}{r}$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (r n : ℕ),\n  ↑(n + 1 - r) ^ r / ↑r.factorial ≤ ↑(n.choose r)",
      "informal_description": "For natural numbers $r$ and $n$, the inequality $\\frac{(n + 1 - r)^r}{r!} \\leq \\binom{n}{r}$ holds, where $\\binom{n}{r}$ denotes the binomial coefficient counting the number of ways to choose $r$ elements from a set of $n$ elements.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.choose_lt_pow",
      "informal_name": "Binomial Coefficient Inequality: $\\binom{n}{k} < n^k$ for $k \\geq 2$ and $n \\neq 0$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {n k : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → 2 ≤ k → n.choose k < n ^ k",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $n$ and $k$ with $n \\neq 0$ and $2 \\leq k$, it holds that $\\binom{n}{k} < n^k$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    }
  ]
}

items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → ℕ},
  (Nat.multinomial s fun i => 2 * f i) ≤ ((∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ ∑ i ∈ s, f i) * Nat.multinomial s f
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ and a function $ f : s → \mathbb{N} $, the multinomial coefficient with all exponents doubled satisfies $ \text{multinomial}(s, 2f) \leq \left(\sum_{i \in s} f(i)\right)^{\sum_{i \in s} f(i)} \cdot \text{multinomial}(s, f) $.

items.type: ∀ (n k : ℕ), n.choose k ≤ n ^ k
items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\binom{n}{k}$ is less than or equal to $n^k$.
For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\binom{n+1}{k}$ is less than or equal to $2^n$.

items.informal_name: Upper Bound for Binomial Coefficient: $\frac{(n + 1 - r)^r}{r!} \leq \binom{n}{r}$
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (r n : ℕ),
  ↑(n + 1 - r) ^ r / ↑r.factorial ≤ ↑(n.choose r)
items.informal_description: For natural numbers $r$ and $n$, the inequality $\frac{(n + 1 - r)^r}{r!} \leq \binom{n}{r}$ holds, where $\binom{n}{r}$ denotes the binomial coefficient counting the number of ways to choose $r$ elements from a set of $n$ elements.

items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $n$ and $k$ with $n \neq 0$ and $2 \leq k$, it holds that $\binom{n}{k} < n^k$.
